newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor privatisation set for Oct 15.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor privatisation set for Oct 15.

text.p: State-controlled cement-maker Cimpor, next in line for sale under the government's plan, said that the next phase of its privatisation was set for October 15.

A company spokeswoman had been asked by Reuters to comment on an unsourced report in O Publico newspaper saying that the bourse session for the opening of offers at the privatisation would be held on October 16.
"It will be October 15," the spokeswoman said.
The government has far not given a timetable for the privatisation of Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal SA and it is not known when the sales process will begin.
The government plans to offer up to 45 percent of the cement-maker in the privatisation which would involve the sale of 37.8 million shares.
Cimpor, 20 percent of which is already on the market, was trading at around 3,345 escudos ($21.62) per share on Monday.
